title: Time estimates and charge-duration mentions
summary: This topic clusters varied references to minutes, including charging behavior, drive or wait times, system timing, and route estimates, with most examples lacking clear sentiment.

positive.summary: One positive review says a short period in the vehicle improved occupant comfort.

negative.summary: One negative review describes a charging-related issue occurring across different states of charge and persisting after a software update.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention assorted timing details such as charging duration, drive time, software-update waiting, auto-lock timing, route estimates, and brief delivery orientation without enough context for clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment evidence is limited.
The cluster mixes several unrelated subjects linked mainly by time expressions, including charging, navigation, comfort, software updates, locking behavior, and delivery experience.
Examples are insufficient to form a more specific single-issue summary without overstating coherence.
